content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The limitations of platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are well-documented. They often come with steep fees, restrictive policies, and inconsistent payment processing. But what about when these platforms fail you? What about when you're left with delayed payouts, unexplained account freezes, or outright payment rejections? That's where our sovereign digital commerce stack comes in – a self-sufficient, infrastructure-agnostic solution that puts you in control of your payments and your business. With our stack, you can process transactions directly on-chain, without relying on intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal. This means faster payment processing, lower fees, and more control over your business operations.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy our sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need a few key components. First, you'll need a digital product to sell – whether it's an ebook, a course, or a software license. Next, you'll need a cryptocurrency wallet to receive payments in USDT or other supported cryptocurrencies. You'll also need a hosting platform for your digital products, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. And, of course, you'll need our NOWPayments integration to process transactions on-chain. Once you have these components in place, you'll be ready to deploy our stack and start [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-pdf-guides-without-gumroad-which-architecture-actually-2|COREMERCH guide to selling]] your digital products with confidence.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a crucial step in deploying our sovereign digital commerce stack. First, you'll need to integrate our NOWPayments solution with your hosting platform and cryptocurrency wallet. This will allow you to process transactions directly on-chain and receive payments in USDT or other supported cryptocurrencies. Next, you'll need to set up a delivery pipeline for your digital products – whether it's through Google Drive, Cloudflare R2, or another cloud storage provider. This will ensure that your customers receive their digital products promptly and securely.
With our NOWPayments solution, you can receive payments in USDT in as little as 1-2 minutes, depending on network congestion.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This is an exciting moment – the culmination of all your hard work and planning. To process your first transaction, simply follow our step-by-step guide to integrating our NOWPayments solution with your hosting platform and cryptocurrency wallet. Once you've completed these steps, you'll be able to process transactions and receive payments in USDT or other supported cryptocurrencies. And with our NOWPayments solution, you can rest assured that your transactions will be secure, fast, and reliable.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your sovereign digital commerce stack is up and running, it's time to scale and grow your business. This means integrating our Complete Builder Kit ($197) with your existing infrastructure, which will give you access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. With our kit, you'll be able to easily add new products, payment gateways, and delivery pipelines to your stack – all while maintaining control over your infrastructure and operations. And with our 24/7 support team, you'll be able to get help whenever you need it.
